subject.title: fix(synology-chat): bound outbound NAS response bodies to prevent Gateway OOM

question: Should Synology Chat accept 1 MiB as the hard `user_list` response boundary, or should that limit be recalibrated before merge?
rationale: A finite limit is required to prevent memory exhaustion, but repository behavior and reviewed documentation do not define which large Synology installations must remain supported, so automation cannot safely choose the compatibility envelope.

options.title: Keep 1 MiB
options.body: Accept the submitted bound and cache fallback as the supported `user_list` compatibility envelope.

options.title: Recalibrate the limit
options.body: Measure a representative large Synology installation and raise the bounded constant with an explicit safety margin.

options.title: Split the POST fix
options.body: Land the certain status-only response fix now and defer the user-list boundary until deployment evidence is available.

recommendation.title: Keep 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Accept the submitted bound and cache fallback as the supported `user_list` compatibility envelope.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged history around Synology resource bounds and the exact shared body-reader seam.
